# science

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
*The daily surface of verifiably: the layer people and agents use*

The commands a researcher or a coding agent runs in place of a folder of scripts and result tables: state a question as a typed claim, hold the data, declare the analysis, run it sealed, verify it from scratch, and read what the checked results add up to. Its scientific records live in a beliefs corpus, checked by the kernel, so the work stays traceable whoever did it. A CLI and an MCP server.

Authority: `docs/commands.md`, `docs/sessions.md`

## Install

From a checkout, with `atoms`, `nodes`, and `beliefs` checked out beside it as sibling
repositories (`python/pyproject.toml` takes `beliefs` from `../beliefs`, which takes
`atoms` and `nodes` from `../atoms` and `../nodes`):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/verifiably/atoms
git clone https://github.com/verifiably/nodes
git clone https://github.com/verifiably/beliefs
git clone https://github.com/verifiably/science
cd science && git config core.hooksPath .githooks
cd python && uv sync --frozen
```

From the repository root, `just test-one <pytest args>` runs a focused test selection,
`just check` runs the hygiene checks, and `just test-full` forces the full test suite on
a certified host (see `AGENTS.md` for the test execution policy and hosted CI split).

## Usage

Start with [Using science](docs/guide.md): explicit configuration, a synthetic
source-checkout example through its verdict, and the path for your own data and
analysis. Writes require certified storage; runs require normal confinement.
The example uses public fixtures and demonstrates plumbing, not a biological finding.

From `python/` after installation:

```sh
uv run science status --config /absolute/path/science.toml
uv run science build
uv run science adapters build --out /absolute/path/generated-adapters
```

World commands read `--config` or `SCIENCE_CONFIG`; configuration is never
discovered from the working directory. Initialize/admit roots through the
[kernel's write protocol](https://github.com/verifiably/beliefs/blob/main/docs/writes.md),
then name them in [configuration](docs/configuration.md). CLI writes use an
attended `science serve --config <file>`; `science mcp serve --config <file>`
provides the same command dispatcher over stdio. See [sessions](docs/sessions.md).

The command surface is recorded in `tools/cli.toml`:

- Analysis: `dataset`, `claim`, `spec`, `run`, `assess`, `verify`, `belief`, `next`, `recheck`.
- Coordination: `project`, `question`, `hypothesis`, `task`, `decide`, `revise`,
  `reuse`, `project-select`, `projects`, `project-show`.
- Sharing: `publish`, `publish-preview`, `provider-inspect`, `provider-bind`,
  `adopt`, `fetch`, `show`.
- World and tooling: `status`, `build`, `epoch`, `serve`, `mcp`, `adapters`.

Scientific writes are kernel acts recorded in beliefs corpora. Selection and
sharing leave session-ledger evidence; science's registry projects sharing lines.
Historical sharing commentary is retained separately beside the ledger for exact
replay. [Sharing](docs/sharing.md) explains acceptance and those retention costs.
`belief` computes its answer: honest `NoBelief` is distinct from zero or a refusal.

### Research skills

With the generated science plugin installed, `/science:sweep-assumptions`
compares research questions across explicitly named permitted inputs. It preserves
discovery before feasibility assessment in an eight-part report. It makes no
scientific record writes or biological analyses. Authored skills are product inputs;
the adapter build includes them in the harness plugin.

## Layout

- `commands/` — one declaration and prompt per command.
- `skills/` — authored research workflows.
- `adapters/` — generated harness adapters.
- `python/` — package, dispatcher, CLI, MCP and tests.
- `docs/` — current public references. Task records and historical working documents
  live in the maintainer's separate records home; application use does not need it.
